confidence_notes: Restaurant meal, cappuccino and draft-beer anchors use Venice price averages last updated 15 October 2026. Wine and cocktail estimates are informed by a current Cannaregio bar menu. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates and are especially uncertain because Venice nightly prices vary sharply by season and location.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Venice-specific prices. Accommodation reflects holistic estimates for a high-demand, historic European tourist city, with a substantial Venice premium.
